home.faq1Question: How do I export Instagram followers to CSV?
home.faq1Answer: Install the IG Export Chrome extension, open any public Instagram profile, choose followers or following, and click Export. Your list downloads as a clean CSV file — no account or spreadsheet cleanup needed.
home.faq2Question: Can I export an Instagram following list to Excel?
home.faq2Answer: Yes. IG Export supports CSV, JSON, HTML, Markdown and Excel (.xls) formats, so you can open your exported follower lists directly in Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers.
home.faq3Answer: Yes, there is a free plan with limited exports that never expires. Pro unlocks unlimited exports, all formats, complete data fields, and project management with tags.
home.faq4Question: Does my Instagram data leave my browser?
home.faq4Answer: No. IG Export is local-first: all parsing and export happen inside your browser. Your exported files and lead projects are stored locally, never uploaded to a server.
home.faq5Question: What data fields can I export about each follower?
home.faq5Answer: Username, full name, bio, profile link, website, follower count, following count, post count, verified status, private/public status, and more on Pro.
home.faq6Question: Is it safe to use an Instagram export tool?
home.faq6Answer: IG Export reads only public profile data from your own logged-in browser session, processes it locally, and requires no passwords or API keys. Use it responsibly and in line with Instagram's terms.
home.faq7Question: Can I use exported follower lists for lead generation?
home.faq7Answer: Yes. Marketers use IG Export to build prospect lists — export a competitor's or niche audience, filter by bio keywords and websites, then organize leads with tags and projects.
home.faq8Question: Do I need an Instagram account to export data?
home.faq8Answer: You browse Instagram as usual in your own browser; IG Export needs no separate account, login, or password — and no IG Export account is required to start on the free plan.

toolPage.faq1Question: Can I export someone else's Instagram followers?

supportPage.title: Support & Help
supportPage.description: Answers to the most common questions about installing, exporting, licenses, and billing. Can't find what you need? Contact us directly.
supportPage.gs1Desc: Open the Chrome Web Store listing and click Add to Chrome. IG Export appears as a popup and full-page workspace.
supportPage.gs2Desc: No account needed — export up to 550 followers or 50 detailed profiles right away to see the data quality.
supportPage.gs3Desc: After buying a pass, copy the license key from your Dodo Payments email, open the extension → License & plans, paste the key, and activate.
supportPage.ts1Question: An export stops or returns fewer rows than expected
supportPage.ts1Answer: Instagram applies rate limits to every account. Wait a few minutes and retry. The export always resumes from a fresh session — your previously exported data stays safe in your projects.
supportPage.ts2Answer: Check for typos and make sure you copied the full key from the Dodo Payments email. A key is bound to one browser at a time — deactivate the current browser in License & plans before moving it to another device.
supportPage.ts3Question: Excel file opens with a warning or wrong format
supportPage.ts3Answer: Excel export uses the .xls format (not .xlsx). Both open fine in Excel and Google Sheets. If you need strict .xlsx, export as CSV and open it in Excel instead.
supportPage.ts4Question: The extension UI language doesn't match Instagram's
supportPage.ts4Answer: IG Export follows your browser language. Instagram's own UI language does not affect exports — profiles in any interface language are exported identically.
supportPage.ts5Question: Exported data looks incomplete for some profiles
supportPage.ts5Answer: Private accounts and accounts with minimal public information return fewer fields. That data simply isn't public — no export tool can retrieve it.
supportPage.bill1Answer: A pass is a one-time purchase that unlocks Pro features for a fixed period: 1 month, 3 months, or 1 year. Passes never auto-renew — you buy again only when you want to.
supportPage.bill2Question: How long is my license valid?
supportPage.bill2Answer: From activation: 1-Month Pass for 1 month, 3-Month Pass for 3 months, 1-Year Pass for 12 months. The extension shows the remaining time under License & plans.
supportPage.bill3Question: Can I use my license on another computer?
supportPage.bill3Answer: Yes. Deactivate the license in your current browser first (License & plans → Deactivate), then activate it on the new device. One browser at a time.
supportPage.bill4Question: How do I get a refund or invoice?
supportPage.bill4Answer: Payments are processed by Dodo Payments. For invoices, refunds, and payment questions, use the customer portal link in your Dodo Payments receipt email.
supportPage.contactDescription: Still stuck? Email us and we'll get back to you within 1–2 business days. Include your browser version, a screenshot if possible, and — for billing issues — your payment reference (never post your license key publicly).

introPage.title: Introduction
introPage.description: IG Export is a local-first Chrome extension that turns public Instagram data into clean spreadsheets. Read this page first if you are new to the tool.
introPage.whatBody: IG Export is a Chrome extension that runs entirely in your browser. It reads the publicly visible data of any public Instagram profile — followers, following lists, and per-profile details — and packages it as CSV, JSON, Excel, HTML, or Markdown. No data ever leaves your browser.
introPage.concept1Body: IG Export works only with public profiles and the data Instagram makes visible to a logged-in session. Private accounts and fields Instagram does not surface simply do not appear in the export.
introPage.concept2Body: Every export happens inside your browser tab. Nothing is uploaded: there is no IG Export backend for your data, and the extension does not require an API key.
introPage.concept3Body: Exports can be grouped into named Projects (e.g. one per campaign) and labelled with custom tags. This turns a raw follower list into organised, searchable lead data.
introPage.concept4Body: Paid plans are one-time passes — 1 month, 3 months, or 1 year. They never auto-renew. Your license key unlocks Pro features for the pass duration.
introPage.audience1Body: Build prospect lists from a niche audience, competitor followers, or hashtag communities, then push them into your outbound flow.
introPage.audience2Body: Collect public profile data for audience analysis, academic studies, and trend reports without writing scrapers.
introPage.audience3Body: Export followers of any public account, filter by bio keywords and websites, and feed the cleaned list into your CRM.
introPage.audience4Body: Audit influencer audiences, analyse follower growth, and report structured numbers to clients.
introPage.next1Body: Install the extension and export your first CSV in under two minutes.
introPage.next2Body: See every data field IG Export captures, with descriptions and examples.

meta.title: Quick Start — IG Export Documentation
meta.description: Install IG Export, export your first Instagram follower list, and get a CSV in under two minutes.

quickStartPage.title: Quick Start
quickStartPage.description: From install to your first CSV in under two minutes — no account, no setup, no code.
quickStartPage.step1Body: Open the IG Export Chrome Web Store listing and click Add to Chrome. Confirm the permissions, and the IG Export icon will appear next to your address bar.
quickStartPage.step2Body: Visit any public Instagram account in your browser. Make sure you are logged into Instagram in that browser tab — the extension uses your existing session to read public data, not a separate login.
quickStartPage.step3Title: 3. Open IG Export and pick followers or following
quickStartPage.step3Body: Click the IG Export icon and choose Followers or Following from the popup. Pick your preferred format (CSV, JSON, Excel, HTML, or Markdown).
quickStartPage.step4Body: Press Start export. The first batch downloads immediately, and you can stop or extend it any time. The free plan covers up to 550 followers or 50 detailed profiles per export; paid passes raise the limit to 50,000.
quickStartPage.step5Body: Open the downloaded file in Excel, Google Sheets, or Numbers. Every column is structured, typed, and labelled. From here you can filter, sort, and import into your CRM.
quickStartPage.next1Body: Group your exports into named Projects and tag them for follow-up.
quickStartPage.next2Body: Review every captured field in the Supported Fields reference.
quickStartPage.next3Body: See plan limits and one-time passes on the Pricing page.

meta.title: Troubleshooting — IG Export Documentation
meta.description: Fixes for common IG Export issues: export stops, license activation, Excel formats, missing fields, rate limits.

troubleshootingPage.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshootingPage.description: Common issues and how to fix them. If your issue is not listed, contact support.
troubleshootingPage.section1Intro: Most export failures come down to Instagram rate limiting, network stability, or session state. Try these in order.
troubleshootingPage.ts11Answer: Wait 5–10 minutes and try again. Instagram applies rate limits to every account. IG Export saves what it has already collected, so the next export continues from a fresh session without losing data.
troubleshootingPage.ts12Question: Exported rows are fewer than expected
troubleshootingPage.ts12Answer: Private accounts and accounts with sparse public info return fewer fields. Empty cells simply mean Instagram doesn't make that data public — no tool can retrieve it.
troubleshootingPage.ts13Answer: Reload the Instagram tab so the extension can re-establish its read of the public data, then click Start export again. Your previous files remain saved in your Projects.
troubleshootingPage.ts14Answer: Profiles with hundreds of thousands of followers run into Instagram's own rate limits. Split the work into several shorter exports over time rather than one continuous run.
troubleshootingPage.section2Intro: An IG Export pass is delivered as a license key in your Dodo Payments email.
troubleshootingPage.ts21Answer: Open the extension → License & plans. Paste the entire key (including dashes) into the License key field and click Activate license. The current key is also counted as a browser instance.
troubleshootingPage.ts22Answer: Your key is bound to one browser at a time. Open License & plans on the browser that currently has it and click Deactivate, then activate on the new browser.
troubleshootingPage.ts23Question: I never received the license key email
troubleshootingPage.ts23Answer: Check spam and promotions folders. Dodo Payments sends the key from a no-reply address within a few minutes of payment. If the receipt arrives without a key, contact support with the payment reference.
troubleshootingPage.ts31Question: Excel opens with a 'file format may be incorrect' warning
troubleshootingPage.ts31Answer: IG Export's Excel output is the .xls format (not .xlsx). Both open normally in Excel and Google Sheets. If you need strict .xlsx, export CSV and use Excel's Save As.
troubleshootingPage.ts32Question: A CSV cell looks truncated or shifted
troubleshootingPage.ts32Answer: Some bios contain line breaks or commas. IG Export quotes those cells in the CSV; if your viewer ignores quotes, use a different spreadsheet app or import to Google Sheets.
troubleshootingPage.ts33Question: JSON looks different from the docs
troubleshootingPage.ts33Answer: Field names match the Supported Fields reference exactly. If you see extra fields, they are extension-side metadata (such as exported_at) — safe to ignore or filter out.
troubleshootingPage.ts41Answer: No. Instagram does not expose private account data to any third-party client. IG Export only reads the same data you can see while logged in.
troubleshootingPage.ts42Question: The extension UI doesn't match Instagram's language
troubleshootingPage.ts42Answer: IG Export follows your browser language. The Instagram interface language does not change the data you can export — profiles in any interface language are exported identically.
troubleshootingPage.ts43Answer: No. All parsing and storage happen inside your browser. Only network requests to Instagram (and Dodo for license verification) leave the extension.
